description: Hetzner DNS, through the Hetzner Cloud API, of a zone in Hetzner's console. A change is done once Hetzner says so.

api_token.description: An API token of the project of the zone, with read and write: in Hetzner's console, under Security, API tokens.

ttl.description: The records' TTL, as 5m or 1h. Default: the zone's.
